nb_intro: Manager-driven placement (Performance × Potential). Supervisors draft; managers approve/publish. Confidential — you only see the employees within your span of control.
nb_sugg_hint: Accept the suggested position or readjust the tier & trend manually — both place the person on a 3×3 micro-grid inside the box.
nb_red_intro: Red (low-performance) box → a PIP has been
nb_blue_intro: Blue (high-potential) box → an IDP proposal has been
nb_followup_error: Placement approved, but the automatic follow-up could not be created:
nb_cell_diamond_desc: Either learning a new role and needs development, or a mismatch between the person and the role — define a new career plan to keep engagement.
nb_cell_shooting_desc: Strong potential, may deliver beyond the current role. Performance meets expectations. Promotable at least 1 level up (within 2–3 years).
nb_cell_gold_desc: Very strong, consistent performance. Exceptional potential — ready to take a role at least 1 level up immediately.
nb_cell_dilemma_desc: New to the organisation or role. Shows capability/skill — may have future potential.
nb_cell_critical_desc: Good performer — may take on more in the current role. Room to grow; further assessment of growth potential needed.
nb_cell_emerging_desc: Very strong, consistent performance. May progress one step up within 1–3 years. Needs development to unlock full potential.
nb_cell_concern_desc: Performing below expectations and/or trending downwards; no sign of further potential — requires action.
nb_cell_essential_desc: Competent but may not excel in a higher role — maintain in current position while assessing potential. Keep engagement.
nb_cell_trusted_desc: Seasoned, very valuable professional — not promotable into management; potential mentor. Keep engaged.

lc_intro: Record joiner / mover / leaver events for your people. Joiner enrols the employee into the open cycle; leaver deactivates the account.

dsp_intro: Open and escalated rating disputes for your team. Resolve with a final rating.

succ_step2_title: 2 · Critical roles with no named successor

succ_no_unscored: Every occupied role in your span is scored.
succ_no_gap: Every critical role in your span has at least one named successor.
succ_none_due: No plan has reached its review date.
